meta_description: Summer's Gardening in Birmingham offers garden maintenance, landscaping, and seasonal care. Friendly, reliable local gardener. Call 07743 104952 for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Local Birmingham Gardener — Garden Care You Can Trust
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to seasonal maintenance, Summer's Gardening transforms Birmingham gardens into spaces you'll love spending time in.
services_subhead: Whether you need a one-off tidy or year-round maintenance, we handle every aspect of garden care with attention to detail.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Upkeep
services.desc: Regular lawn mowing, hedge trimming, and seasonal weeding keep your garden looking sharp. Weekly or fortnightly visits fit around your schedule.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim neglected outdoor space. We clear dense vegetation, remove brambles and ivy, and haul away debris, leaving you with a blank canvas to work with.

services.title: Landscape Design & Installation
services.desc: Transform tired garden layouts with new pathways, raised beds, decking, or hardscaping. We'll design a space that works for how you actually live.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Borders
services.desc: Spring colour or autumn interest — we'll choose hardy plants suited to your soil and sunlight, then plant and nurture them to establish quickly.

services.title: Tree Pruning & Removal
services.desc: Safe pruning to encourage healthy growth, or full removal of dead or dangerous trees. All waste is cleared and composted responsibly.

services.title: Garden Tidy-Ups & One-Off Projects
services.desc: Got a special event coming up? We handle spring cleans, patio jet-washing, fence repairs, and one-off jobs without tying you into a contract.

about_pullquote: I started this because too many gardens are neglected. Mine shouldn't be yours.
about_para_1: Summer's Gardening was born from frustration — watching brilliant Birmingham gardens fall into disrepair because local help was hard to find. Over 12 years, we've built a reputation by showing up on time, doing the job properly, and treating every garden like it matters. We work for homeowners across South Birmingham and beyond, and every project gets the same care whether it's a quick mow or a full redesign.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we listen. We don't push unnecessary work, we explain what needs doing and why, and we'll suggest cost-effective alternatives if you ask. Repeat bookings make up 70% of our work — that tells you everything. Whether you're house-proud or completely overwhelmed, we'll get your garden into shape and keep it there.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant work. Garden was an absolute jungle when Summer came out — took him three visits to sort it properly, but the difference is incredible. Fair prices too, which is rare these days. Will have him back for regular upkeep.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using Summer's for nearly three years now. Come out every fortnight without fail, always friendly and professional. My garden looks great and I don't have to think about it. Couldn't ask for more.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Had the whole garden redesigned. Summer listened to what we actually wanted rather than just pushing his ideas. Planted everything in spring and it's really taken off. Honestly brilliant bloke to work with.
reviews.author: David P.
